infotexts.JobDescription.mechanic_arcane: A mechanic who protects the submarine with machinery and magic.
infotexts.JobDescription.mechanic_mystic: A mechanic who turns damage and broken machinery into combat strength.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Mechanic_Arcane: Hold in both hands and use or aim to read. Requires a base mechanic, both primary talent stages completed, Mechanical 80 and Magic 60. Consumed on registration. Activates next round or on a new mechanic body after death. Lose 40% of total experience on activation and reselect profession talents; talents outside the old profession tree, skills and equipment remain.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Mechanic_Mystic: Hold in both hands and use or aim to read. Requires a base mechanic, both primary talent stages completed, Mechanical 80 and Weapons 60. Consumed on registration. Activates next round or on a new mechanic body after death. Lose 40% of total experience on activation and reselect profession talents; talents outside the old profession tree, skills and equipment remain.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_ArcaneMechanic_: Raise the skill level cap to 120.
+30% hull repair speed. Devices you finish repairing deteriorate at half speed. This talent does not repeatedly stack the deterioration reduction.
+1 crafted item quality and +50% skill gain speed.
Take 15% less attack damage inside submarine compartments, including flooded rooms.
Deal 20% more blunt trauma and 10% more lacerations.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_FracturedMechan: Melee damage increases linearly as health falls: 0% at full health, up to 30% at zero health.
Incoming attack damage decreases linearly as health falls: 0% reduction at full health, up to 20% at zero health.
Average your repair speed bonus and hull repair speed bonus. Each 1% grants 0.1% ranged attack damage, capped at 15%. The base 100% speed is not counted.
Each 1% maximum health bonus grants 1% ranged attack damage, capped at 15%.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_Special_Mechani: +10% effective skill levels. Each Mechanical skill point grants 0.05% damage to all attacks, capped at 10%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.Touhou_FracturedMe: Legacy save compatibility state. Fury now grants melee damage through its stat-scaling talent ability.
